## Objective
- Complete and verify the existing playable five-world adventure based on the ULTITANKIST_RUT boss concept.

## Requirements
- Four worlds each award one ancient-artifact fragment; all four open the citadel gate.
- Objectives: Abandoned City—find keys; Digital Nightmare—defeat glitches; Forgotten Desert—find an artifact; Cosmic Abyss—open a portal; Citadel—defeat ULTITANKIST_RUT.
- Boss phases: Normal Form (energy attacks and teleportation), GLITCH FORM (space distortion and digital copies), ABSOLUTE FORM (red energy and arena destruction).
- Preserve the boss’s final line and secret ending: “ULTITANKIST_RUT hasn't finished his game yet...”
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Retained the existing Three.js implementation.
- Fixed the malformed `.vignette` CSS gradient and changed a quoted toast string to avoid curly-quote parsing issues.
- Added `scene.add(obj)` in `addEntity` after testing showed registered entities were not parented into the scene.

- Existing implementation includes five worlds, objectives, artifact fragments, combat, a three-phase boss, and the secret ending.
- Verified `node --check src/main.js` and `git diff --check` pass.
- Browser opened and started the game; movement and objective collection were observed working when the player reached a collectible.

### Active
- Finish gameplay validation for all world objectives/transitions, all four fragments and citadel gate, boss phases, and ending.

- `src/main.js`: Three.js gameplay, objectives, combat, boss logic, endings, and temporary test hook.

- `index.html`: Game canvas, HUD, controls, and start overlay.

- Browser testing used `playwright-cli` at `http://localhost:3002`; browser is currently in a started game state.
